list.name: cohort_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT type FROM integrations.cohorts ORDER BY type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.value AS stage, COUNT(uc.user_telegram_id) AS count
FROM integrations.cohorts c
JOIN integrations.user_cohorts uc ON uc.cohort_id = c.id
WHERE c.type = '$cohort_type'
  AND LOWER(c.value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
GROUP BY c.value
ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(st.created_at, '1d', 0) AS time,
  st.new_value AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM integrations.stage_transitions st
WHERE st.cohort_type = '$cohort_type'
  AND $__timeFilter(st.created_at)
  AND LOWER(st.new_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  c.value AS id,
  c.value AS title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_telegram_id)::bigint AS mainStat
FROM integrations.cohorts c
JOIN integrations.user_cohorts uc ON uc.cohort_id = c.id
WHERE c.type = '$cohort_type'
  AND LOWER(c.value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
GROUP BY c.value

WITH trans AS (
  SELECT old_value, new_value, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM integrations.stage_transitions
  WHERE cohort_type = '$cohort_type'
    AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND old_value IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(old_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
    AND LOWER(new_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
  GROUP BY old_value, new_value
),
totals AS (
  SELECT old_value, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM trans GROUP BY old_value
)
SELECT
  LEAST(fwd.old_value, fwd.new_value) || '->' || GREATEST(fwd.old_value, fwd.new_value) AS id,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(fwd.cnt,0) >= COALESCE(bwd.cnt,0)
    THEN fwd.old_value ELSE fwd.new_value END AS source,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(fwd.cnt,0) >= COALESCE(bwd.cnt,0)
    THEN fwd.new_value ELSE fwd.old_value END AS target,
  GREATEST(COALESCE(fwd.cnt,0), COALESCE(bwd.cnt,0))::bigint AS mainStat,
  ROUND(
    GREATEST(COALESCE(fwd.cnt,0), COALESCE(bwd.cnt,0))::numeric
    / NULLIF(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(fwd.cnt,0) >= COALESCE(bwd.cnt,0)
          THEN tf.total ELSE tb.total END,
        0
      ) * 100, 1
  ) AS secondaryStat
FROM trans fwd
LEFT JOIN trans bwd ON bwd.old_value = fwd.new_value AND bwd.new_value = fwd.old_value
LEFT JOIN totals tf ON tf.old_value = fwd.old_value
LEFT JOIN totals tb ON tb.old_value = fwd.new_value
WHERE fwd.old_value < fwd.new_value OR bwd.old_value IS NULL

WITH real_transitions AS (
  SELECT
    user_telegram_id,
    old_value,
    new_value,
    created_at
  FROM integrations.stage_transitions
  WHERE cohort_type = '$cohort_type'
    AND (old_value IS NULL OR new_value <> old_value)
),
stage_periods AS (
  SELECT
    user_telegram_id,
    new_value AS stage,
    created_at AS started_at,
    LEAD(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_telegram_id ORDER BY created_at) AS ended_at,
    LEAD(new_value) OVER (PARTITION BY user_telegram_id ORDER BY created_at) AS next_stage
  FROM real_transitions
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    stage,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at)) / 86400)
          FILTER (WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL
                    AND next_stage IS NOT NULL
                    AND next_stage <> stage
                    AND ended_at >= $__timeFrom()
                    AND ended_at <  $__timeTo())::numeric, 1) AS "Вышли в период",
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - started_at)) / 86400)
          FILTER (WHERE ended_at IS NULL)::numeric, 1) AS "Ещё на стадии"
  FROM stage_periods
  WHERE LOWER(stage) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive', 'hold')
  GROUP BY stage
)
SELECT stage, "Вышли в период", "Ещё на стадии"
FROM agg
WHERE "Вышли в период" IS NOT NULL OR "Ещё на стадии" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY GREATEST(COALESCE("Вышли в период", 0), COALESCE("Ещё на стадии", 0)) DESC
